lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dusty boots on the sagging porch
Watching the shadows begin to lean
The sun sinks low behind the pines
Painting the fields in shades of gold
[Pre-Chorus]
The crickets start their steady hum
The cooling air begins to still
[Chorus]
The memories are seeds in the ground
Growing wild in the garden of time
A long road leads to a quiet place
Where the heart finds its steady beat
[Verse]
A rusted gate with a heavy groan
The scent of rain on drying hay
A faded quilt across a wooden chair
The ticking clock keeps the steady pace
[Pre-Chorus]
The moon climbs high above the roof
The world falls into a silver sleep
[Chorus]
The memories are seeds in the ground
Growing wild in the garden of time
A long road leads to a quiet place
Where the heart finds its steady beat
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
One foot forward through the tall grass
One mile back to where I started
[Chorus]
The memories are seeds in the ground
Growing wild in the garden of time
A long road leads to a quiet place
Where the heart finds its steady beat
[Outro]
